title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace drop: C-17 Globemaster, Taylorcraft BC-12D & new releases breakdown!
description:
Are you looking to expand your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 hangar this week, or are you trying to decide which new add-ons are worth your investment? Today, we are breaking down a diverse wave of recent Marketplace releases spanning everything from strategic military heavy transports and high-altitude surveillance drones to regional twin jets, native backcountry bush planes, and flight deck overhauls.

In this deep-dive marketplace breakdown, we cover flight dynamics, new MSFS 2024 native features, trial options, system fidelity, and visual upgrades to see which add-ons deserve a spot on your virtual flight line:

✈️ MILITARY OPERATIONS & STRATEGIC TRANSPORT
We start with the iconic Boeing C-17 Globemaster III—a massive four-engine high-lift strategic transport featuring cargo bay ops, functional ramp physics, and heavy-payload flight dynamics across career, photo, and free flight modes. We also inspect the Heaven Designs RQ-4 Global Hawk, bringing high-altitude long-endurance (HALE) unmanned recon operations, 8K PBR texturing, and custom ground control station cockpits to the simulator.

⚡ COMMERCIAL & BUSINESS AVIATION
Looking for speed and passenger routes? We evaluate RM Studios' budget-friendly Boeing 737 MAX 7 and break down what systems are shared under the hood. Then, we step inside the sleek Embraer Phenom 300E by Sim Federation—a light corporate twin capable of Mach 0.78 cruising at FL450 with full VR cabin integration. Finally, we take a close look at Vertigo Sim’s ATR 72-212A regional turboprop, equipped with dual FMS navigation, weather radar, advisory VNAV, deep system simulation, and a risk-free 1-day free trial.

🌲 GENERAL AVIATION & BACKCOUNTRY
For stick-and-rudder enthusiasts, Got Friends delivers their flagship Taylorcraft BC-12D, built entirely native for MSFS 2024. Featuring over 100 customization options across classic, backcountry, ski, and float configurations, this bird introduces advanced water-skimming and bush-tire physics alongside an open 1-day trial. We also fly the turbocharged Alpi Aviation Pioneer 400, a fast European tourer boasting dual G3X touch glass avionics and retractable gear.

🚁 ROTORCRAFT & LIVERY PACKS
We wrap up with essential utility updates, including the PXP engine and rotor flight model overhaul for the default Asobo H125, paired with the US Medical Medevac livery pack. Plus, we check out new high-res airline liveries for the Captain Sim 777F and historic liveries (including classic Air Force One) for the Boeing 707.

Which of these releases are you loading onto your ramp first? Testing the free trials on the Taylorcraft and ATR, hauling heavy freight in the C-17, or cruising high in the Phenom 300E? Let us know in the comments below!

If you find these marketplace breakdowns helpful, don't forget to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and clear skies on your next flight!
